status: Planning allowances, not a supplier quotation
quantity_basis: Patch-component allowances assume a 1000-patch procurement scenario; this is not a one-off prototype checkout price.
assumptions: Six short sheets at 6 USD each and two full sheets at 12 USD each; no linear price per taxel assumption.
Fixed controller and auxiliary patch cost retained for short sheets.
400 USD isolated gateway, 12 USD regional distributor, 40 USD regional harness, 15 USD box and strain relief per region.
Ten-region reference additionally budgets two 50 USD USB hubs.
excludes: spares and rework beyond the stated patch allowance
warning: Industrial price assumptions can underestimate a home-lab build. Obtain actual quantity-specific quotes before ordering.

full_patch_model_inputs.short_sheet_scenario_rule: Hold modeled full-patch cost less 12 USD sheet allowance fixed at 22.78; replace sheet by 6 or 12 USD allowance. This is a conservative scenario, not a measured short-patch manufacturing quote.
